movelist.name: Needle Arm
movelist.effect: Needle Arm Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Cotton Spore
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Speed lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Synthesis
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value instead. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value instead.

movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

abilities.name: Storm Drain
abilities.trigger: A ranged Water Type Move is used within 10
abilities.effect: The Move is turned into a 1-Target Move and is re-directed at the user without fail, and cannot miss. This negates Lock-On or Mind Reader.  the user’s Special Attack is then raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Confusion. Defensive.
